# Monte Carlo Simulation of Campus Bus Arrivals

```{r bus-simulation}
set.seed(2026)

daily_totals <- replicate(10000, {
  early_morning <- sum(rpois(3, lambda = 4))
  morning_peak <- rnorm(1, mean = 45, sd = sqrt(16))
  midday <- sum(rpois(6, lambda = 15))
  afternoon_peak <- rnorm(1, mean = 55, sd = sqrt(25))
  evening <- sum(rpois(6, lambda = 9))
  # Return the total number of passengers
  early_morning + morning_peak + midday + afternoon_peak + evening
})

# Estimate the expectation by averaging across days.
estimated_mean <- mean(daily_totals)
theoretical_mean <- 3 * 4 + 45 + 6 * 15 + 55 + 6 * 9
results <- data.frame(
  simulated_days = length(daily_totals),
  estimated_mean = estimated_mean,
  theoretical_mean = theoretical_mean
)

print(results, row.names = FALSE)
```

The simulation estimates an average of
`r round(estimated_mean, 2)` passengers per day.

The theoretical expectation is 256
